name: source-articles
notes: Hardcoded input filename: 10000_articles_without_linebreaks.csv. The space in 'article text' is required.

name: translated
notes: Writes translated_articles.csv. 'body' is the original Danish.

name: summarized
notes: Reads translated_articles.csv but slices [:10] before the loop. Default output: summarized_file_ml80_rp5.0.csv.

name: labeled
notes: English summary column is dropped. Danish silver labels land in 'summary'. Default output: labeled_dataset_ml80_rp5.0.csv.

name: finetune-split
notes: Expects datasets/train_dataset.csv, validation_dataset.csv, test_dataset.csv. Same three columns as the labeled file.

name: public-eval
notes: Nordjylland news summarization on the Hub. eval.py loads alexandrainst/nordjylland-news-summarization; use_model.py loads ScandEval/nordjylland-news-summarization-mini.
